text:
maya: Heads up — nightly eval run flagged multiple function-call/schema failures on redwood-r1-8-q4_0 (quant). Dumping one sample we hit locally.

maya: ```json
{
  "name": "rerank",
  "arguments": "{\"candidates\":[{\"id\":1,\"text\":\"foo\"}] }"
}
```

jon: That looks like the model returned a stringified JSON in `arguments` instead of an object. Repro only on q4_0?

maya: Confirmed — r1-8-fp16 passes clean. Only q4_0 and q4_1 variants show this pattern.

angela: Validator log shows: `TypeError: expected list for 'candidates', got str` when the schema validator runs. Short log: 

angela: ```py
# evals/validator.py
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "evals/validator.py", line 88, in validate_fncall
    items = payload['arguments']['candidates']
TypeError: string indices must be integers
```

tariq: Sounds like nested escaping: the model emits a JSON string literal rather than a parsed object. Could be decode-time quoting or a tokenization quirk amplified by the quantized kernels. We've seen similar but not this nested.

maya: Reproducer command: `python -m tests.repro --model redwood/r1-8:quant-q4_0 --seed 42 --case 4821`

maya: Reproducer printed this on decode: 

maya: ```
function_call: name=rerank args="{\"candidates\":[\"{\\\"id\\\":1,\\\"text\\\":\\\"foo\\\"}\"]}"
```

jon: Nested double-escaping. Two likely spots: 1) model emitted an escaped JSON string; 2) serve/runtime postprocessor accidentally coerced bytes->str and applied escaping.

angela: Quick mitigation: in the eval harness try `if isinstance(arguments, str): arguments = json.loads(arguments)` before validation so nightly doesn't flood failures. But that masks the root cause if the model really started returning strings.

jon: Agreed we should not permanently silence it. File a GH issue and add a short-term scrub in CI so customers don't get blocked by noise.

maya: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/issues/2492 with sample outputs and failing ids (4821, 4827, 4833...). Assigned to eng-ml.

eval-bot: Nightly eval run 2024-06-15T03:12:00Z finished with 17 failures. Full run results: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/runs/2024-06-15-0312

angela: I'll add the temporary `try: json.loads` patch with a unit test and mark WIP. Won't merge without review.

jon: Nice. Assigning angela/tariq to triage, label=regression/nightly, component=evals. :thumbsup:

maya: Will follow up if more variants fail or if the fix reveals a deeper decoder issue.
